addr: # VETTE.EXE (DOS 1.1 EN) symbol map. Source of truth for naming; applied to Ghidra by re/ghidra_scripts/VetteApplySymbols.java.
# kind: func | data | label. Data sizes are noted in comments (b=byte w=word d=dword).

name: start
comment: Real entry point (after EXEPACK). Sets DS=124Ah and runs init and the main menu loop.

name: detect_cpu_class
comment: push sp/pop ax 8088 test, then idiv loop for 0x124 PIT ticks (~1 s). Returns AX 0=8088/slow 1=medium 2=fast; fast clears cs:0E26/0E27.

name: cpu_slow_flag_a
comment: b; 0xFF unless detect_cpu_class says fast. Copied to 124A:2AC7 at startup.

name: cpu_slow_flag_b
comment: b; 0xFF unless detect_cpu_class says fast. Copied to 124A:2ABE at startup.

name: game_outer_loop
comment: Outer loop: menus / garage / race setup. Re-entered from 3009:008A 00B2 0618.

name: frame_loop
comment: Per-frame loop head (back-edge 3009:061B). See re/notes/02-frame-loop.md.

name: video_set_mode_ega_0e
comment: INT 10h mode 0Eh (EGA 640x200x16). Double-buffer pages at A000 and A400.

name: video_page_seg_a
comment: w; A000h

name: video_page_seg_b
comment: w; A400h

name: frame_measure_rate
comment: Inside the main frame loop: xchg pit_ticks with 0 -> elapsed (min 1); frame_rate = round(291/elapsed), min 4.

name: frame_rate
comment: w; frames per second measured each frame. The simulation scales per-frame motion by this.

name: race_ticks
comment: d; accumulated PIT ticks (291.3 Hz) for the race clock.

name: race_seconds
comment: w; race_ticks / 0x123 (291). The real rate is 291.27 Hz so the clock runs ~0.1% slow.

name: race_clock_tick
comment: race_clock_update then race_ticks += pit_ticks (before the frame loop resets pit_ticks).

name: race_clock_update
comment: race_seconds = (race_ticks + pit_ticks) / 291.

name: timer_init
comment: Sound init then PIT ch0 divisor 0x1000 (291.3 Hz) then installs ISRs.

name: timer_install_isrs
comment: Hooks INT 08h -> int08_timer and INT 1Ch -> int1c_joystick_buttons.

name: timer_restore
comment: Restores INT 08h/1Ch and PIT divisor 0 (18.2 Hz).

name: int08_timer
comment: IRQ0 at 291.3 Hz: ++pit_ticks; every 4th IRQ runs timer_work (72.8 Hz).

name: timer_work
comment: 72.8 Hz: snd_engine_pitch_tick + snd_seq_tick; every 4th call chains to BIOS INT 08h (keeps 18.2 Hz time of day).

name: pit_set_ch0_divisor
comment: BX = divisor (0 = 65536).

name: pit_ticks
comment: w; incremented at 291.3 Hz. Read-and-reset by the frame loop.

name: work_ticks
comment: w; incremented at 72.8 Hz.

name: old_int1c
comment: d

name: old_int08
comment: d

name: int1c_joystick_buttons
comment: 18.2 Hz: reads joystick buttons (port 201h bits 4-5) into joy_buttons.

name: joy_buttons
comment: b

name: snd_play
comment: AX = sequence pointer (cs-relative). Starts playback if sound_enabled.

name: snd_stop
comment: Speaker off and points the sequence at the idle sequence 92C0.

name: spk_set_divisor
comment: Speaker on, PIT ch2 mode 3 (B6h), divisor CX.

name: snd_seq_tick
comment: 72.8 Hz sequence step. Entries are {w duration, w divisor}: divisor -1 = rest, duration 0 = jump back by divisor bytes, duration -1 = end.

name: snd_engine_set_target
comment: Engine-note slide direction from engine_speed vs previous value.

name: snd_engine_pitch_tick
comment: 72.8 Hz engine-note pitch slide (divisor at cs:92A8 limited to 0x1400..0xB000).

name: sound_enabled
comment: b

name: snd_seq_engine
comment: Engine-note sequence (divisor slides in place).

name: snd_engine_slide
comment: w; bit15 = slide down. Low bits = rate.

name: snd_seq_count
comment: w

name: snd_seq_ptr
comment: w

name: engine_speed
comment: w; drives the engine-note pitch (compared against 0x14/0x35). Speed or RPM - TBD.

name: kbd_install
comment: Saves INT 09h into cs:0000 and installs kbd_isr (far; called from start).

name: kbd_restore
comment: Restores the original INT 09h.

name: kbd_isr
comment: INT 09h keyboard handler (reads port 60h).

name: old_int09
comment: d

name: kbd_state
comment: 11 words of key state written by kbd_isr.

name: kbd_clear_state
comment: Zeroes kbd_state and cs:003C.
